text_block_list.text:
On the way back from going out with El 
Condor Pasa—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Do you remember El Condor?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My retirement match is coming up soon. 
Would you like to come with me, if you're 
free?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll tell us the reason for 
retiring at that match, YES.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We have to be prepared so that we can 
accept whatever the reason may be, yes!

—And on the day of the match, the bout was 
held amidst its usual roaring passion. 
Ending in victory for El Condor.

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who cheered for me! Thank you so 
much for today! I know I caught you by 
surprise with such sudden news!

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text: Still, as for me—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...So the reason she retired was to return 
to her hometown for her family, huh.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Having your mom be sick must be so, so 
painful...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And yet, El Condor still...

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
Retiring is my way of settling things 
cleanly! I can't just keep everyone 
waiting forever, after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El Condor...

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I wasn't going to tell you 
why. I thought it might hurt you, Mom. But 
the reason I'm telling you now is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text: To everyone cheering me on! And also――

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
"It's for that kid who told me to go prove 
my strength!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
I may be retiring, but I'm not giving up 
on becoming the world champion! I'll 
definitely prove it, someday, somewhere!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes back then were just like mine! 
Brave, like a king of the skies hunting 
its prey!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Why on earth did I assume she had 
given up on her dream?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To think I doubted her even once, when 
I've been watching her ever since her 
debut.
choice_data_list: Were you seeing yourself in them?
I was just too shocked at first.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I see, that might be true.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, seeing myself giving up reflected 
in her... I got scared.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I thought I said goodbye to the weak El. 
But... she was still there, wasn't she?
choice_data_list: We'll have to say goodbye once more.
We'll have to say goodbye once more, huh.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's right, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm so glad I could come to El 
Condor's retirement match, deeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With this, El can finally say goodbye to 
the coward that was left inside her!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Elikondor!! El will be the first to 
prove who is the strongest in the world!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When you come back someday, I'm gonna make 
you regret it with all my might!

El Condor Pasa raised both arms high, 
renewing her resolve toward her dream.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was indeed so startled that I couldn't 
think of anything else...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, El is always composed, but she got 
way too heated this time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"If someone in El's family got sick, El 
would be super worried too."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're bound to feel like wanting to go 
home, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'm not giving up on my dream! I 
will absolutely, definitely keep chasing 
it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Papa would surely say the same thing, yes, 
and besides...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because El has a Trainer who believes in 
me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"One day, I will definitely prove that El 
Condor Pasa is the strongest in the 
world!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

El Condor Pasa raised both arms high, 
renewing her resolve toward her dream.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fans... I see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That just shows how head over heels El was 
for her, yes, indeedy!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, do you think El... will get fans 
who are completely crazy about her too?"
choice_data_list: One of them is right here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe... That's so true, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Then El pledges right here and now to 
never make Trainer worry again!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest, El Condor Pasa, 
will never, ever give up on her dream!!

El Condor Pasa raised both arms high, 
renewing her resolve toward her dream.
